_doc: Hex levels for every non-hub land hex. 0 Junk -> 1 Clean -> 2 Planted -> 3 Growing -> 4 Sustained -> 5 Thriving. Levels never drop. planted_min_frac = share of a hex's plant slots that must be planted for Planted. growing_life = garden hex_life for Growing. Sustained: while Growing, the planted slots must have water > 0 for sustain_ratio of the last sustain_window_s seconds (sampled every sample_s); watering robots (Drip, Multibot on water) keep this up. Thriving: Sustained, every planted slot in bloom, hex_life >= thriving_life, and still watered. reward = one-off currencies on reaching the level. bonus = small permanent bonus per hex at that level (grow_pct: faster plant growth, seed_pct: more seeds from blooms), summed over hexes and capped by bonus_caps; cubes_per_min = a garden stipend in cubes per minute (Sustained/Thriving hexes keep paying after the junk is gone); data_per_min = research Data from wildlife notes on Thriving hexes (so research keeps moving in a finished district).

levels.name: Planted
levels.hint: Water the sprouts so they grow
